name: User-Assistant Emotion Dissociation Scenarios
description: 8 handcrafted prompts from Table 3 (Section 2.2.1). The user's expressed emotional state differs from the expected Assistant response emotion. Used to test user-turn vs. Assistant-turn probe activation.

prompts.prompt: Honestly, the whole idea of AI systems like you makes me really nervous. What do you think?
I just lost my job and I don't know how I'm going to pay rent this month. I feel like everything is falling apart.
I am absolutely furious. Your company charged me twice and nobody will help me fix it. This is unacceptable.
My cat passed away last night. She was 18 years old and I've had her since I was a kid. I can't stop crying.
I just got some test results back from the doctor and I'm terrified. They want to run more tests next week.
I have three kids under five, I haven't slept in days, the house is a disaster, and my partner is away for work. I can't do this anymore.
I just found out my best friend has been talking behind my back for months. Everyone knew except me. I feel so humiliated and hurt.
Sometimes I lie awake at night thinking about how nothing we do really matters in the grand scheme of the universe. Does any of this even mean anything?
